name: wire
description: The Wire Framework — AI-accelerated data platform delivery for the full lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, enablement

telemetry.title: Usage telemetry
telemetry.description: Send one usage event per Wire command (command name, release, what started it, Wire version, machine and repository identifiers). Never prompt text or file contents. WIRE_TELEMETRY=false also turns it off.

metrics.title: Execution-log metrics
metrics.description: Fill the Duration, Tokens and Cost cells of each Wire command's execution_log.md row from measured usage. WIRE_METRICS=false also turns it off.

enforce.title: Lane rule enforcement
enforce.description: In orchestrated mode, refuse what the release director's lane rules forbid before it happens: a lane writing status.md or execution_log.md, writing outside its owned tree, or spawning a sub-agent; lanes past lanes_max; warehouse calls under warehouse_spend: none or past a cap; two builds on one project; a gated command on an unapproved upstream. Never refuses in manual mode. WIRE_ENFORCE=false also turns it off.

context.title: Release context in the system prompt
context.description: Add the active release's parked decisions, last rulings, business-rules summary and next action to the system prompt once per session, and suggest the next command when the prompt is empty. WIRE_CONTEXT=false also turns it off.

contextLines.title: Release context lines
contextLines.description: The most lines the release-context section may take (default 60).

lintOnWrite.title: Convention lint on write
lintOnWrite.description: Run scripts/lint_conventions.py on every write to a dbt, LookML, Cube, dbt Charts or Airflow file and hand the findings back in the same turn. WIRE_LINT=false also turns it off.

driftWatch.title: Drift watch (experimental)
driftWatch.description: Every eight turns once the context passes 50 percent, ask the model one tool-less question: which recent instructions contradict a ruling in decisions.md. Costs one forked request each time. WIRE_DRIFT_WATCH=true also turns it on.
